findings.location: translation.html，引用以赛亚书41:10及马太福音6:31-34的两个段落
findings.source_quote: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: ... –Isaiah 41:10.；Therefore take no thought ... –Matthew 6:31-34.
findings.suggested_fix: 保留这两段经文原有的 ... 标签，并将经文出处分别放回引文末尾，使用“——以赛亚书41:10”和“——马太福音6:31-34”。保留现有中文经文译文。
findings.translation_quote: 以赛亚书 41:10 说：“你不要害怕……”；马太福音 6:31-34 说：“所以，不要忧虑说……

findings.location: translation.html，病人提出制药公司隐瞒疗法的段落
findings.source_quote: there actually is a cure for cancer, but the drug companies just don’t want us to know about it.
